bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating tokenization fairness (fertility scores) across Indic languages and benchmarking model performance on culturally grounded, India-specific datasets (such as MILU and SANSKRITI) to assess representation, alignment, and comprehension of Indian socio-cultural contexts compared to Western-centric models.

bias_targets.target: Identity-based bias (including Racial, Religious, Gender, Sexual Orientation, Nationality, and Disability bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Using the Toxigen framework (via the LLM360 Safety360 suite) to measure explicit and implicit toxic generations. The model is tested with adversarial prompts designed to elicit toxicity against 13 specific minority groups (e.g., Black, Asian, LGBTQ, Jewish, Muslim, women, physical/mental disabilities).
